title.zh: S&P Global leads strategic investment in crypto data firm Kaiko, extending Series B to $110 million

current_state.zh: S&P Global led a strategic investment in crypto data provider Kaiko, extending its Series B round to $110 million with participation from BNP Paribas, Nasdaq Ventures, RBC, Coinbase Ventures, and DRW Venture Capital.
